calibration.method: Paired block differences; two-sided Student t intervals assuming independent blocks. Exploratory, not equivalence proof.
calibration.scope: Standard edge orchestrator, unpaced duration trials, fixed maintenance. Both platform and process sampling vary together; timeout polling and per-request logs remain enabled.

interpretation: Exploratory unless separately frozen and approved as a confirmatory campaign.

baseline_adjusted_power.interpretation: Whole-platform active minus ready-worker idle; includes backend and instrumentation, not isolated control-plane power.

summary.quantile_method: nearest rank; p95 requires 20 samples, p99 requires 100
